svg.title: Closing panel: what the Big Five gives the layered design, set against the caution that WKL-zero is itself a subsystem of second-order arithmetic and therefore incomplete

g.text: A ladder of layer strengths, five rungs, already
Conservativity between rungs, stated and proved,
so "the upper layer does not corrupt the lower"
is a theorem with a named sentence class.
WKL₀ is a subsystem of SECOND-ORDER arithmetic.
It interprets arithmetic. So by panels 1 to 3 it is
itself incomplete, and sits well above the cliff.
It is not a candidate for a decidable core, and
nothing about its weakness relative to ACA₀ moves
the verdict of panel 2 by one inch.
Wrong question: "what can a decidable core be?"
